claims.text: NSAIDs @ about 20 wks or later may cause fetal renal dysfunction → oligohydramnios
claims.quote: Use of NSAIDs, including CELEBREX, at about 20 weeks gestation or later in pregnancy may cause fetal renal dysfunction leading to oligohydramnios and, in some cases, neonatal renal impairment.

claims.text: If needed: lowest effective dose, shortest duration
claims.quote: If an NSAID is necessary at about 20 weeks gestation or later in pregnancy, limit the use to the lowest effective dose and shortest duration possible.
